reviews.text: A very nice shop with a wide range of products. The staff is very attentive and happy to help. Definitely recommended!

A very nice shop! The staff are very knowledgeable and gave me great advice on what to get for my cat. The shop has a wide range of products and you can find everything you need for cats there. Highly recommended!

This is a fantastic shop for cats; they really have everything for every cat! And this Animal Day is no exception: a surprise box full of fun and tasty treats for the cat. Even the cat's staff aren't forgotten; they thought of that too. Super, thank you so much 4 Cats!!!!

Good selection of products, but unfortunately I’ve experienced uninterested staff every time I’ve visited.

Last time, I asked a young male employee for advice. He said, “I actually don’t know anything about that, my boss would know.” He then seemed ready to end the conversation without doing anything further. I had to ask, “Aren’t you going to ask then?” as I was actually there to buy something. It would be nice to see a bit more initiative and willingness to help.
Exceptional Shop, a Little Paradise for Kitten Children and Little Cat Men.😻 …

Great in store variety and specialty for cats however the shopping experience was not so great from the unfriendly staff who wasn’t willing to assist. Non chalant facial expressions and doesn’t seem bothered. Perhaps she’s a cat too in her past life.

Amazing shop! I’ve been coming here all the way from Deventer to Amsterdam specifically for years, and it’s more than worth every kilometer.🙏 They have an extensive range, and over the years they’ve helped me incredibly well with all my questions and always give honest and expert advice. You’re the best!!❤️ …
This is a great little store, which is small in size but packed with merchandise. I definitely recommend checking with them for cat food, treats, and accessories.
Very nice shop, friendly staff and extensive range.

I always come here to get things for my cat, it's a really nice shop. The staff is always super friendly and all the products are high quality! My cat mainly loves the cat grass, it's amazing!! Another real plus is that you can buy many products individually, so you only buy what you actually need. 🫶🏽 …

I come here to shop almost every week. The girl behind the counter is always friendly and asks how my kitties are doing.
Here you have a great selection of cat food, treats and toys. We bought a huge scratching post here a few months ago and our furry princesses love it
Everything for the cat and more than at a regular pet store.

I love coming here for my cat, but this time I'm a bit bummed!! Cat grass for 3 euros that is already completely withered after 2 days! Luckily, my mother thought of my cat at the market too and bought a pot of exactly the same thing for 1 euro that is nice and green and will keep my cat happy for a few more weeks!! It's all about the money but not about the quality anymore by 4cats "Too bad"
Unique shop with an amazing and rare selection of goods for kitties and their owners

What a wonderful experience. This was my first day moving to Amsterdam from the US, so I was exhausted and overwhelmed, and the woman who helped me was incredibly kind. And that’s in addition to the store having everything you might need (litter boxes, food, toys etc) 4 your kitty!

The best pet shop ever, with a heart for both people and animals. They have an incredible amount of knowledge, experience, and passion for the business. Our cats love 4 Cats, and so do we! And even our Pomeranian.
Considering the location and the space they have, it's quite extensive with what they have.

Great place, as recommended by a friend, for cat toys. I wanted to get my cats some things whilst on holiday, and the only issue with this store is there are so many choices! I had to really think of what to get within my budget, there is a good amount of variety to choose from (rather than the same toy style repeated). I found toys for all of my cats' personalities!

I'll be visiting this place again the next time I visit Amsterdam, for sure.

It was a very nice store. We have one similar in our neighborhood that we shop at sometimes. Some time ago, the pet shop on Rijnstraat gave me a  bag with “4Cats Amsterdam” written on it, along with a discount coupon for this 4kats shop in Waterlooplein.

Because of that, my boyfriend and I visited the Waterlooplein store together. It’s a nice shop, but we didn’t have anything in mind to buy—we just looked around and then left. I was carrying the bag that the other shop had given me, with the discount codes still inside. It wasn’t even a tote bag, just a very cheap bag.

As we were leaving, a young girl who works at  the store ran after us and asked if we had bought the bag. She basically treated us like we were stealing, which was super weird. I explained that I had gotten the bag earlier along with the discount codes. The whole situation felt uncomfortable, and honestly, I’ll never go back there again because of how we were treated.
What a great shop, so much choice. Top service and good explanations about the products. So much nice selection of cat products. The atmosphere is amazing.
Friendly place with reasonable prices. I do all my cat shopping here :)
This is the first time I've found a store that sells everything a cat needs. You can find everything from food to toys to climbing frames.

This is 'The Place To Be' for cat lovers. The assortment is amazing in every respect. Very friendly staff. The owner is (naturally) a huge cat lover and is always willing to help when you have a question. I bought a water fountain, tried it out, but still wasn't satisfied. I returned the fountain, explained a few things, and got my money back without any hassle. I regularly order their favorite pouches of cat food, which always goes super smoothly. Something not in the assortment? The owner will order it for you if available. This is a top-notch shop, a unique shop, an asset to Amsterdam.

Great pet shop! What more could you want as a cat professional (I'm a cat groomer, I'm adoring) than "so many cat supplies in one place"? 😻😻😻 They also offer excellent advice!

I was incredibly happy with the wide selection of puzzles and brain games. 😸 Their selection allows for wonderful variety. No cat will be bored again. 🐾

Tess
If you have a cat you defiantly need to come here, unfortunately didn’t accept my card for whatever reason so I couldn’t buy what I wanted. Regardless amazing store.
Great store with a huge selection! Always friendly and helpful.
Best cat shop in Amsterdam
What a nice shop. All kinds of useful and tasty things for the cat.

I am very happy with this shop. The selection is top-notch, I always receive great service, and I always get patient and detailed answers to my questions! For my cat's birthday (yes, I am one of those ;-)), I picked up a gift package containing treats I otherwise wouldn't have chosen myself (with insects in them!), but I have never seen my cat so enthusiastic about treats, so I will keep buying them here!

Disappointed…. I came all the way from Lelystad specifically to this shop because I was getting a kitten and wanted to buy some nice things for him. Personally, I had expected a bit more interest or better service at a specialty cat shop; it really wasn't as if they were busy, because there were only two of them working there. I was the only one in the shop with another couple. I enthusiastically told them I was getting a kitten and asked for kitten toys; she walked over to them, and before I could ask anything, she walked away again. I used to go to the cat shop in the Jordaan (unfortunately closed), but at least there they paid attention and at least asked, "Oh, how cute, what kind of kitten…" I am used to getting a different experience or service at specialty shops than you would at a large pet store. Too bad, otherwise I would have come back here often, because they also had nice stuff..
Nice place really good advice
Animal Day was great fun at 4cats! Kat (and I) were very happy with the goodie bag.
Kind people, many products on offer, and fair prices. Would absolutely recommend going if you have a cat.

That’s the best pet shop in the area (if not in the city)! They have a great selection of cat goods, literally anything you wanted (food (including fresh options in the fridge), treats, all types of bowls, drinking fountains, automatic …
